scope.in_scope: copy/input operations whose destination is a finite-capacity byte buffer and whose unchecked extent can be proven unsafe or whose unbounded nature can be proven
scope.out_of_scope: runtime exploitability, attacker capability, precise corruption offset, ASLR/control-flow impact, binary-only effects unless separately modeled
scope.principle: CWE-120 is broad; independent Evidence Families are required where evidence semantics differ.

title: Research graph-observable evidence for Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
